newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks open mixed on light volume.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks open mixed on light volume.

text.p: Australian shares started Tuesday's holiday-shortened session mixed on light volume after the Dow provided a slightly negative lead on Monday.
At 10.15 a.m. (2315 GMT), the All Ordinaries index was 0.4 points firmer at 2,413.3.

Trading on the Australian Stock Exchange finishes at 1.00 p.m. (0200 GMT) ahead of the New Year's day holiday on Wednesday and dealers said as a result many players were absent from the market this morning.
"The market could have gone either way at the open this morning but I expect it will close firmer," a dealer at a Brisbane-based brokerage said.
The dealer said it was likely institutions would take advantage of the thin market to push selected stocks higher near the end of trade to improve the look of their portfolios.

"People have been linking the market's recent strength with synchronised growth of the world's economies. I think the market's lack of liquidity is the main factor -- we could see a shakeout in the new year," the dealer said.
